title: Bakers
description: Mix and bake ingredients to produce breads, rolls, cookies, cakes, pies, pastries, or other baked goods.

tasks.text: Measure or weigh flour or other ingredients to prepare batters, doughs, fillings, or icings, using scales or graduated containers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Set oven temperatures, and place items into hot ovens for baking.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Check products for quality, and identify damaged or expired goods.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Food quality needs taste, smell, physical inspection

dwas.name: Evaluate quality of food ingredients or prepared foods.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Check equipment to ensure that it meets health and safety regulations, and perform maintenance or cleaning, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.
Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Adapt the quantity of ingredients to match the amount of items to be baked.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Food production methods need practical judgment

dwas.name: Determine food production methods.

tasks.text: Place dough in pans, molds, or on sheets, and bake in production ovens or on grills.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cooking with heat and perishable materials

dwas.name: Operate cooking, baking, or other food preparation equipment.

tasks.text: Observe color of products being baked, and adjust oven temperatures, humidity, or conveyor speeds accordingly.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Food product inspection is sensory and hands-on

dwas.name: Inspect food products.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Set time and speed controls for mixing machines, blending machines, or steam kettles so that ingredients will be mixed or cooked according to instructions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cooking with heat and perishable materials

dwas.name: Operate cooking, baking, or other food preparation equipment.

tasks.text: Combine measured ingredients in bowls of mixing, blending, or cooking machinery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of materials into equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Check the quality of raw materials to ensure that standards and specifications are met.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Food quality needs taste, smell, physical inspection

dwas.name: Evaluate quality of food ingredients or prepared foods.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Roll, knead, cut, or shape dough to form sweet rolls, pie crusts, tarts, cookies, or other products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Shaping clay or dough is tactile craft

dwas.name: Shape clay or dough to create products.

tasks.text: Decorate baked goods, such as cakes or pastries.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Apply glazes, icings, or other toppings to baked goods, using spatulas or brushes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Order or receive supplies or equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Prepare or maintain inventory or production records.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

dwas.name: Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cutting equipment operation is manual and judgment-based

dwas.name: Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Develop new recipes for baked goods.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Recipe ideas generated; taste and kitchen execution human

dwas.name: Create new recipes or food presentations.
